title: report-latency
blurb: Customer reports are correct on small accounts but time out in production. The profiler dump is in diagnostics/ — start there.
brief:
The billing team’s nightly **customer spend report** is correct for tiny fixtures but **times out** on production-sized order lists. SRE captured a text profiler dump before the job was killed.

**Start with the evidence.** Read `diagnostics/profiler.txt` and `diagnostics/sre-notes.md` before diving into `report/`. They name the hot frames — and one frame that is *not* the problem.

The tests encode two post-fix invariants:

1. Report totals stay correct on a small fixture.
2. Building a report over thousands of orders may only make a **small constant number of full passes** over the order list (no per-customer full scans).

`tests/` and `diagnostics/` are read-only.

**Your job:** find the algorithmic root cause, fix `report/service.py`, get green. No new files.
